obfuscation_indicators: forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally informative and includes useful customer-concentration, liquidity, covenant, inventory, and pandemic details, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and broad, unquantified risk categories. Key risks include customer concentration, custom inventory exposure, fixed-cost operating leverage, pandemic-related demand volatility, commodity inflation, and covenant history, though current liquidity appears adequate with no LOC borrowings.
